title: Argento Cloudworks
text:
Argento Cloudworks

requirements_summary:
Initial POC on hosted_api (EU endpoints) -> transition to Dedicated (EU) for production
Multi-region routing: primary EU region; passive NA region allowed only for non-PII batch workloads; legal wants hard prohibition on cross-border embeddings
Model preference: smaller instruction-tuned open models (quantized) for cost; allow fallbacks to larger models for complex HR queries
Caching: prefix + KV cache to reduce token cost on repeated HR prompts; embeddings storage must be EU-resident
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboard, audit logs for all inference calls
Rollout plan: canary 10% traffic for 2 weeks before full switch to Dedicated
Key management: customer-managed KMS option required; HSM mention during legal review

notes:
Opened: interested in adding AI triage to HR support flows; current stack: React frontend + Python backend + Postgres
Prefers hosted API for POC to avoid infra costs; committed to move to Dedicated in EU if residency/latency SLOs met
Will not allow customer-identifiable embeddings to leave EU — legal explicit requirement
Target p50 chat latency <= 150ms in EU; throughput baseline 40-60 rps for peak windows
Cost sensitivity: mid-market; prefers predictable committed capacity over burst billing surprises
CTO quote: 'No customer data should leave EU borders' — repeated by Legal on 2026-03-05 call
Asked for fallback routing policy that keeps PII/embeddings in EU; ok with NA for non-PII analytic batch jobs
POC success metrics: meet latency SLO, demonstrate 15-20% improvement in intent classification over TF-IDF baseline, validate KMS integration

next_step:
Finalize EU Dedicated pricing; legal to confirm residency clause; schedule infra cutover call week of 2026-03-15

blockers:
Legal signoff on EU-only processing
Pricing gap vs self-host estimate
Need explicit KMS/HSM integration doc
Latency baseline for Multi-AZ EU region
